description: This file defines a React component named RetroShell that provides a layout with header, main, and footer sections, along with an inline alert component. It manages user authentication state via useAuthStore and handles UI elements such as login/logout links, workspace navigation, and alerts.

methods.name: RetroShell
methods.description: Main layout component displaying header, footer, and children content with user authentication controls.

methods.name: InlineAlert
methods.description: Reusable inline alert component with customizable tone, title, and message.
